title: Lease classification & a finance lease — Granite Logistics
instructions: Granite Logistics (a public company, calendar year-end) entered four leases on January 1, Year 1. Classify each, then account for the forklift fleet lease. Use the PV factor in the exhibit and round to whole dollars.

exhibits.title: Lease terms
exhibits.content:
| Lease | Term | Asset's remaining economic life | PV of payments ÷ fair value | Other terms |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| A. Forklift fleet | 4 years | 5 years | 88% | None |
| B. Office floor | 7 years | 40 years | 22% | Renewal at market rates, not reasonably certain |
| C. Custom packaging line | 3 years | 10 years | 35% | Built to Granite's specs; no alternative use to lessor |
| D. Delivery van | 3 years | 8 years | 45% | Purchase option at $1, exercise reasonably certain |

exhibits.title: Forklift lease (Lease A) details
exhibits.content:
- Payments: **$120,000** per year, due each **January 1**, beginning at commencement.
- The rate implicit in the lease is not known; Granite's incremental borrowing rate is **7%**.
- PV of an annuity due, 7%, 4 periods: **3.62432**.
- No initial direct costs, incentives, or residual value guarantee. Straight-line amortization.

rows.label: A. Forklift fleet
rows.explanation: Term is 80% of economic life (major part).

rows.label: C. Custom packaging line
rows.explanation: Specialized asset with no alternative use to the lessor.

rows.label: D. Delivery van
rows.explanation: Purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised.

rows.label: Lease liability / ROU asset at commencement
Interest expense for Year 1
rows.explanation: After the January 1 payment the liability is 314,918; × 7% = **22,044**.

rows.label: ROU asset amortization for Year 1
rows.explanation: 434,918 ÷ 4 (lease term, shorter than 5-year life; no ownership transfer) = **108,730**.

rows.label: Lease liability at December 31, Year 1 (before the Jan 1, Year 2 payment)
rows.explanation: 314,918 + 22,044 accrued interest = **336,962** (of which 120,000 is due within a year).

parts.prompt: Record Lease A's December 31, Year 1 adjusting entries (interest and amortization) as one compound entry.
parts.explanation: Interest accrues on the liability (credited to the lease liability or interest payable); the ROU asset is amortized straight-line (credit the asset or accumulated amortization). A finance lease reports two expenses, not a single lease cost.
